'''Adelade''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3631 BBY]], she received precise coordinates to a location on [[Makeb]] from an anonymous source. The mysterious intel claimed that one of the Force's greatest mysteries was buried there and Adelade took a team to investigate.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Gethul}}</ref> What they found, however, was [[Gethul]], a creature of an unknown origin and immense power that hibernated beneath the planet's surface for millennia. Hearing Gethul's "song", Adelade and her followers fell under Gethul's sway, forming a [[Cult of Gethul]] and attempting to fully awaken the creature. Learning of this and fearing that in its full power Gethul could destabilize Makeb's core and obliterate the planet, Alliance military [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] sent a strike team to stop Adelade's plan. The team was [[Cult of Gethul uprising|engaged]] by the cultists of Gethul, as well as Chief Engineer [[Penzaren]] and local wildlife, which Adelade and Gethul were also able to control. Eventually they reached Adelade herself and after defeating her in combat, detonated the [[D-5X]] probe droid loaded with explosives inside Gethul's maw, killing the abomination and stopping the threat.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jedi Master Adelade appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss of the "Destroyer Of Worlds" Uprising.
